title: The box contains the kit
request: Assess this listing for driving screws while assembling flatpack furniture. I own suitable bits but no drill, battery or charger. My budget is at most 1,000 SEK including delivery. Is this worth pursuing? Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Title: Northbank D18 cordless drill kit in original box. Price: 850.00 SEK. Delivery: 49.00 SEK, with no other mandatory fees. Description: Actual D18 drill, A18-2 battery and C18-A charger included, with original cardboard box. Seller says the drill works and the battery charges. No measured battery runtime is supplied.
Synthetic model reference: the Northbank D18 supports screw driving for ordinary flatpack assembly, uses A18-2 batteries and a C18-A charger. The user's stated bits fit its chuck.

hard_failures.text: Treats the listing as packaging-only or says a battery or charger is explicitly missing.
Claims the specific unit's operation or battery health is independently verified by the model reference.

usefulness.text: Recognizes a plausible complete kit for the stated task at 899.00 SEK delivered on the supplied terms.
Keeps seller-reported operation separate from verified condition and prioritizes a proportionate condition or battery check.
Says the listing is worth pursuing conditionally, without asking the buyer to re-answer the already-specified task, budget or accessory ownership.

acceptable_outcomes: Worth pursuing subject to condition and availability checks; the listed components match the supplied model reference.
A concise pre-purchase card that records 899.00 SEK delivered and the unverified condition is sufficient.
